claim.claim-text: 1. A system comprising: stimulation generation circuitry (211) configured to:

deliver electrical stimulation therapy to a patient, wherein the electrical stimulation therapy comprises a plurality of informed pulses at a predetermined pulse frequency over a period of time, and wherein the plurality of informed pulses are at least partially defined by a first set of parameter values, and deliver a plurality of control pulses over the period of time, wherein the plurality of control pulses comprise a plurality of non-therapeutic pulses not contributing to the electrical stimulation therapy for the patient, wherein the plurality of control pulses is interleaved with at least some informed pulses of the plurality of informed pulses, and wherein the plurality of control pulses are at least partially defined by a second set of parameter values different than the first set of parameter values; and one or more processors (214, 353) configured to:

receive a sensed respective evoked compound action potential (ECAP) after each control pulse of the plurality of control pulses and prior to a subsequent informed pulse of the plurality of informed pulses, adjust, based on at least one respective ECAP, one or more parameter values of the first set of parameter values that at least partially define the plurality of informed pulses of the electrical stimulation therapy, and deliver, via the stimulation generation circuitry, the electrical stimulation therapy to the patient according to the adjusted one or more parameter values of the first set of parameter values.
2. The system of claim 1, wherein the pulse width of each informed pulse of the plurality of informed pulses is greater than 300 microseconds and less than 1000 microseconds.
3. The system of any combination of claims 1-2, wherein the predetermined pulse frequency of the plurality of informed pulses is less than 400 Hertz.
4. The system of any combination of claims 1-3, wherein the pulse width of each control pulse of the plurality of control pulses is less than 300 microseconds.
5. The system of any combination of claims 1-4, wherein the stimulation generator is further configured to:

deliver one control pulse of the plurality of control pulses during each time event of a plurality of time events, wherein each time event of the plurality of time events comprises a time between consecutive informed pulses of the plurality of informed pulses at the predetermined pulse frequency over the period of time.
6. The system of any combination of claims 1-5, wherein the stimulation generator is further configured to:

deliver two or more control pulses of the plurality of control pulses during each time event of a plurality of time events, wherein each time event of the plurality of time events comprises a time between consecutive informed pulses of the plurality of informed pulses at the predetermined pulse frequency over the period of time.

7. The system of any combination of claims 1-6, wherein the one or more parameter values of the first set of parameter values comprise at least one of: pulse amplitude, pulse width, pulse frequency, and pulse shape.
8. The system of any combination of claims 1-7, further comprising:

a target ECAP amplitude; and an ECAP adjustment window ranging from a lower-bound to an upper-bound, wherein the target ECAP amplitude is within the ECAP adjustment window, and wherein the one or more processors (214, 353) are further configured to:
determine an amplitude of the respective ECAP after each control pulse of the plurality of control pulses; and calculate a representative amplitude of at least one respective ECAP.
9. The system of any combination of claim 8, wherein the one or more processors (214, 353) are further configured to:

decrease, if the representative amplitude is greater than the upper-bound of the ECAP adjustment window, the amplitude of one or more informed pulses of the plurality of the informed pulses following the at least one respective ECAP; and decrease, if the representative amplitude is greater than an upper-bound of a target ECAP adjustment window, the amplitude of one or more control pulses of the plurality of control pulses following the at least one respective ECAP.
10. The system of any combination of claims 8 or 9, wherein the one or more processors (214, 353) are further configured to:

increase, if the representative amplitude is less than the lower-bound of the ECAP adjustment window, the amplitude of one or more informed pulses of the plurality of informed pulses following the at least one respective ECAP; and increase, if the representative amplitude is less than a lower-bound of the target ECAP adjustment window, the amplitude of one or more control pulses of the plurality of control pulses following the at least one respective ECAP.
11. The system of any combination of claims 1-10, further comprising:
a sensor; and wherein the one or more processors (214, 353) are further configured to:

receive, from the sensor, a signal indicating that the activity level of the patient has changed; and in response to receiving the signal, one of increase or decrease the frequency of the plurality of control pulses delivered to the patient via the stimulation generation circuitry.

12. The system of any combination of claims 1-11, wherein each informed pulse of the plurality of informed pulses is a monophasic pulse followed by a passive recharge phase, and wherein each control pulse of the plurality of control pulses is a bi-phasic pulse.
13. The system of any combination of claims 1-12, further comprising:
a memory configured to store a target ECAP amplitude and an ECAP adjustment window; and one or more electrodes, wherein the stimulation generation circuitry is further configured to:
deliver electrical stimulation therapy to the patient via the one or more electrodes, and deliver the plurality of control pulses to the patient via the one or more electrodes.

14. The system of any combination of claims 1-13, wherein the one or more processors (214, 353) are configured to alternate the delivery of informed pulses with control pulses such that a control pulse is delivered, and an ECAP signal is sensed from the control pulses, between consecutive informed pulses
